description:
Purpose: Explain every search field and its values, and map job departments to their families and titles.
When: Before you pick a field the user did not spell out, or when a search result is ambiguous.
Cost: About 710 tokens for the field list and about 2370 for the departments breakdown.

field.description: Which field to explain; leave it out for every field, or use department for the department map.

value.description: A department slug, only with field department, to read that department's every family and role.

name: job_postings_search_fields

outputSchema.description: The search fields explained, or the department map.

department.description: One department with every family and role; present for a department value.

exampleTitles.description: Two typical job titles of the department.

families.description: Every family in the department with its roles.

slug.description: The department slug the department filter takes.

departments.description: Every department with its largest families; present for the department field.

exampleTitles.description: Two typical job titles of the department.

slug.description: The department slug the department field takes.

fields.description: Every search field with its values; present when no field argument was given, or for the field asked for.

default.description: What the search uses when the field is left out.

limits.description: The bounds or the rule the field's value must follow.

name.description: The field's parameter name in job_postings_search.

type.description: The kind of value the field takes.

values.description: Every value the field takes, with its meaning.

value.description: The value to send in the field.

title: Explain search fields
